claims.verbatim:
The steamers Etna and Louisiana left Liverpool on the
28th[?] for New York, calling at Queenstown.

claims.verbatim:
Steamship Louisiana (Br.), Thomson, Liverpool May 30, via Queens-
town June 1, with mdse. and 373 pass. to the National Steam Naviga-
tion Co. The L. had light easterly winds and fine weather the entire
passage.

New York Herald, 14 June 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Louisiana (Br), Thomson, Liverpool May 30,
via Queenstown 1st inst, with mdse and 373 passengers, to
the National Steam Navigation Co. Had light easterly winds
and fine weather the entire passage. 11th inst, lat 40 42[?], lon
66[?], passed a steamer (supposed one of the National Com-
pany's), bound E; 12th, lat 40 43, lon 70 23, passed a U S
man-of-war, steering E.
